title: Software Architecture & Delivery Basics — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates a broken production rollout: demonstrates automated canary analysis detecting HTTP 5xx spikes and triggering instant 1-click rollback to the prior stable release.
routing_rationale: Cloud Deploy monitors real-time deployment health metrics. If canary targets breach error budget thresholds, traffic is instantly reverted without waiting for manual SRE intervention.

nodes.label: Canary Pod (v2.1 Buggy)
nodes.detail: Throws uncaught null pointer exception on 15% of inbound requests.

nodes.label: Cloud Monitoring SLO Alert
nodes.detail: Detects HTTP 500 error budget burn rate exceeding 14x threshold.

nodes.label: Cloud Deploy Controller
nodes.detail: Executes automated rollback hook; patches Kubernetes target back to v2.0.

nodes.label: Stable Pod Fleet (v2.0)
nodes.detail: Healthy prior release absorbs 100% of production traffic safely.

steps.title: Error Budget Burn Detection
steps.action: Canary pod emits 5xx errors; Cloud Monitoring detects severe error budget burn.
steps.why_traversal: Automated telemetry flags software defects before full production exposure.

steps.title: Automated Rollback Signal
steps.action: Monitoring fires webhook to Cloud Deploy API requesting rollback.
steps.why_traversal: Eliminates human delay during high-severity production degradations.

steps.title: Traffic Reversion
steps.action: Cloud Deploy resets load balancer weights, routing 100% traffic back to v2.0.
steps.why_traversal: Instantly restores user experience while defect is investigated.

steps.title: Faulty Pod Eviction
steps.action: GKE sends SIGTERM to canary pods, terminating failed release cleanly.
steps.why_traversal: Reclaims cluster resources and locks pipeline until patch is committed.

scenarios.label: Database Schema Incompatibility
scenarios.root_cause: v2.1 application code expected columns not yet present in production database.
scenarios.diverted_path: All canary requests fail with SQL syntax exceptions; automated rollback triggers.
scenarios.blast_radius: Confined to 10% canary traffic for under 45 seconds.
scenarios.recovery: Deploy forward-compatible database migrations before releasing new application binaries.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Simulates a broken production rollout: demonstrates automated canary analysis detecting HTTP 5xx spikes and triggering instant 1-click rollback to the prior stable release.
